title: KitchenCourseReadyPayload
description: Payload of `kitchen.course.ready` version 1. Every line of a course is ready or served. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

partner_id.description: The Location's Partner; the envelope's `partner_id` too.

source.description: What the ticket came from: `order` or `round`.

order_id.description: The order, which for a round is the tab.

tab_id.description: The tab of a round; `null` for a delivery or a pickup.

round_id.description: The round; `null` for a delivery or a pickup.

at.description: When it happened: for a mark, the moment it was made.

line_ids.description: The order's or the round's lines of the course.
